description:
Read a fresh VPS over ssh (uses your ~/.ssh/config, so `host` is any
    alias/Tailscale-name/user@ip that `ssh <host>` already works for) and return
    structured facts: OS, CPU/RAM/disk, python, what's already installed, which
    ports are taken, outbound reachability, and a `looks_clean` verdict.
    READ-ONLY - changes nothing.
name: vps_inspect
